question: Should the official memory-lancedb plugin in this repository add BM25/full-text hybrid retrieval, or should enhanced LanceDB retrieval stay in external ClawHub/community plugins?
rationale: The requested behavior is a real parity gap, but adding it changes official plugin config/search semantics and fallback behavior, which needs owner intent before an automated implementation should proceed.

options.title: Sponsor official memory-lancedb parity
options.body: Add hybrid retrieval to the existing official plugin with explicit config, safe defaults or opt-in behavior, dependency proof, docs, and regression coverage.

options.title: Keep enhanced LanceDB external
options.body: Close or redirect this request to ClawHub/community plugin work such as memory-lancedb-pro, leaving the official plugin vector-only.

options.title: Defer to memory roadmap
options.body: Keep this open but block implementation until maintainers choose the recommended memory backend path and plugin ownership model.

recommendation.title: Sponsor official memory-lancedb parity
recommendation.body: Add hybrid retrieval to the existing official plugin with explicit config, safe defaults or opt-in behavior, dependency proof, docs, and regression coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: He already performed the prior detailed review and has the strongest local history signal on memory-lancedb and memory plugin direction.
